title: recursion left open — review required
description: recursion runs with an open setting: recursions+yes. Open binds, trust auth, and disabled protections expose the service to unauthenticated networks. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms isolation or hardens it.
remediation: Apply no plus trusted-ACL recursion and verify from an untrusted network.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of network isolation.
